verdict.rationale: Pika's Swap Anything app documents replacing characters, outfits, backgrounds or props inside an existing video. A paint-the-area editing flow targets only a selected region, which implies the rest of the frame is kept. However, the explicit 'restyle' claim is documented for images, not video clips, and no evidence confirms that unedited parts of the frame actually stay intact. Missing for 10: documented restyling of an element within video, explicit evidence that the rest of the frame is preserved, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can replace or restyle an element inside an existing video while the rest of the frame stays intact
